def bad_character_heuristic(self):
    """
    Finds all occurrences of the pattern in the text.
    :return: A list of all positions of the pattern in the text, list.
    >>> boyerMooreSearch = BoyerMooreSearch("ABAABA", "AB")
    >>> boyerMooreSearch.bad_character_heuristic()
    [0, 3]

    """
    results = []

    if self.patLen > self.textLen or self.patLen == 0:
        return results

    current_pos = 0

    while current_pos <= self.textLen - self.patLen:
        match_found = True
        for i in range(self.patLen):
            if self.pattern[i] != self.text[current_pos + i]:
                match_found = False
                break

        if match_found:
            results.append(current_pos)

        if not match_found:
            mismatch_idx = self.mismatch_in_text(current_pos)
            if mismatch_idx != -1:
                mismatch_char = self.text[current_pos + mismatch_idx]

                # Find rightmost occurrence of the mismatched character in pattern
                last_occurrence = self.match_in_pattern(mismatch_char)

                # Calculate shift distance
                if last_occurrence != -1:
                    shift = self.patLen - 1 - last_occurrence
                else:
                    shift = self.patLen

                # Also consider the good suffix (from mismatch index)
                good_suffix_shift = self.patLen - mismatch_idx - 1
                shift = max(shift, good_suffix_shift) if shift > 0 else 1
                shift = max(shift, 1)

            current_pos += shift
        else:
            current_pos += 1

    return results

    def mismatch_in_text(self, currentPos):

        # Check each starting position in text
